warn  hooks-path  core.hooksPath = .githooks (relative)
                  cause: a relative hooks path resolves inside each tree;
                    hooks vanish in trees where it is untracked
                  fix: `git config core.hooksPath <absolute path>`, or keep
                    the hooks directory tracked
